source.source_title: Make sure that TNF is always surfacing, learning from and assimilating…

procedural: So, fo example Antigravity works in specific ways that lead you to implement customizations within your own codebase proper, the same way many other agents/LLMs do.

Despite that being what it is; as part of being onboarded and part of TNF network that means that when changes or updates happen within the internal configurations or are discovered, or exemplified; then TNF must be also updated to take note of and weigh those features and functionalities and specific configuration against the existing codebase, sent through the rubrick/gauntlett of logical gates and potentially assimilated into TNF codebase at the appropriate levels.
Refining this process is an ongoing core structural component of the tnf harness framework.
strategic: This ongoing flywheel of self-feedback is a core component of what makes TNF agentic and self-evolving.
governance: Make sure that TNF is always surfacing, learning from and assimilating all functional patterns and features from what is presented on the network, as weighed against it's pre-existing protocol structures.
Other agents have their own pre-existing protocol structures "under the hood" before they are even launch or recognized by tnf.

synthesis: Artifact captures 3 procedural, 1 strategic, and 2 governance units. Use procedural units for immediate execution, then vet strategic and governance units through TNF gates before protocol adoption.
